title: Concentrix Named One of the 2026 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces™
summary: Recognition highlights the leadership, communication, and culture that shape the experience of game-changers around the world.

## Recognition highlights the leadership, communication, and culture that shape the experience of game-changers around the world.


**NEWARK, Calif.** (September 24, 2026) –[Concentrix Corporation](https://www.concentrix.com/news/) (NASDAQ:[CNXC](https://ir.concentrix.com/) ), a global technology and services leader, announced today it has been named one of the 2026 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces™, recognizing organizations that create exceptional experiences for their people through strong leadership, inclusion, communication, wellbeing, and opportunities for growth.


At Concentrix, this achievement is driven by its game-changers. Across the company, teams are building connections, supporting one another, and creating opportunities for people to contribute their best work in meaningful ways. A place among the Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces reflects the collective efforts of those individuals and teams around the world.


The Inspiring Workplaces Awards evaluate organizations across several areas that influence workplace culture and employee satisfaction. For Concentrix, those strengths include:


- **Belonging and inclusion:** building a workplace grounded in respect and connection
- **Transformational leadership:** empowering teams and driving positive change
- **Wellbeing support:** promoting mental, emotional, and physical health
- **Open communication:** keeping employees informed and connected
- **Continuous learning:** helping people build new skills and capabilities
- **Shared purpose:** creating value for clients, communities, and one another


As the Intelligent Transformation Partner for its people and clients, Concentrix understands that strong organizations are built by orchestrating people, technology, and ways of working. That same approach helps teams collaborate, adapt, and deliver results.


To learn more about life at Concentrix, visit[concentrix.com](https://www.concentrix.com/) or[jobs.concentrix.com](https://www.jobs.concentrix.com/) .


### About us: Powering a World That Works


Concentrix (NASDAQ: CNXC), is the Fortune 500® technology and services company, helping the world’s best brands create intelligent operations that perform in the real world. We design, build, and run integrated human and AI solutions, harnessing the insight from billions of real-world interactions to help 2000+ of the world’s most complex organizations solve their toughest business challenges. Backed by 20+ years of operational experience and battle tested AI, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that helps clients across every major industry move from ambition to measurable, scalable performance. Virtually everywhere. Visit[concentrix.com](https://www.concentrix.com/) to learn more.
